title: If the OK button is missing. Quite stupid for the kids ;)
symptom: The OK button is missing on the screen, which is problematic for children using the app.
cause: The OK button is not visible because the screen is not scrolled down or because all details are enabled, causing the button to be out of view.
fix: Scroll down to see the OK button, or disable the checkbox next to the eye icon to hide details and make the buttons immediately accessible.
